text:
The sister’s children’s shifting executory interest is void under the common-law Rule Against Perpetuities: the church-use condition may occur, and an afterborn child may reach 25, more than 21 years after every life in being in 1960 has ended. Striking that interest leaves the friend with a fee simple absolute, and later births and deaths do not revive it. Title is in the friend only (A).

CONFIDENCE: 88
